sentence_text: (i) determine within 20 days (excepting Saturdays, Sundays, and legal public holidays) after the receipt of any such request whether to comply with such request and shall immediately notify the person making such a request of –

proposals.quote: determine within 20 days (excepting Saturdays, Sundays, and legal public holidays) after the receipt of any such request whether to comply with such request

context.quote: Each agency, upon any request for records made under paragraph (1), (2), or (3) of this subsection, shall—

proposals.action: determine whether to comply with the request within 20 working days after receipt
proposals.subject: determination
proposals.allowed_example: A request received on a Monday is determined on or before the twentieth working day after that Monday.
proposals.forbidden_example: A request received on a Monday is still undetermined on the twenty-fifth working day after receipt, with no extension notice and no tolling.

proposals.quote: determine within 20 days (excepting Saturdays, Sundays, and legal public holidays) after the receipt of any such request whether to comply with such request
proposals.subject: whether to comply with the request
proposals.allowed_example: The agency decides whether to comply with the request.
proposals.forbidden_example: A program, or anyone other than the agency, decides whether to comply with the request.

proposals.quote: shall immediately notify the person making such a request of –
proposals.action: notify the person who made the request of the determination immediately
proposals.subject: notice of determination
proposals.allowed_example: The agency sends the requester the determination on the day it is made.
proposals.forbidden_example: The agency makes a determination and sends no notice to the requester.
